chapter.verse: Caesar Tiberius kumpi a suah khit kum sawmlengana laitak Pontius Pilate pen Judea gam-uk mangpa hi a, Herod pen Galilee ukpi, a sanggampa Philip pen Ituraea leh Trachonitis ukpi, Lysanias pen Abilene ukpi ahi uh hi.
Tua laitak, siampi lianpenpa Annas leh (ama' khit-a sem)e Caiaphas' hun sungin gamgawtak lak-a om Zechariah' tapa John' tungah Pasian' hopihna hong tung hi.
Tua ciangin Jordan gun kimnai khempeuh ah John pai kawikawi a, mawhmaina ngah nadingin kisikna tawh kisai baptizena thu tangko hi.
Tua pen kamsang Isaiah' thugenna laibu sunga kigelhsa bang ahi hi: "Gamgawtak laka kikopa' awging in hih bangin gen hi: 'Topa' lampi sialkhol unla, ama' zawi tangsak un.
Kuam kici khempeuh kivuk ding a, mualsang mualbo kici khempeuh kiniamsak ding hi. a phok munte kinelsak ding hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in Pasian' hotkhiatna mu ding uh hi.'"
Tua hi a, John in ama' kianga kibaptize dinga hong pai mihonpi' kiangah, "No mualtan' suante! Hong tung ding hehna pan taikhiat ding kua in hong phawng hiam?

Tu-in kisikna tawh a kituak gah, gah un. Noleno, 'I pa Abraham i nei hi,' kicih sawmkha kei un. A hang pen ke'n kong cihin ah Pasian in hih suangtumte pan Abraham' ading suanlekhak khangkhiasak thei hi.
Tu-in zong singkung phungte ah hei kikoih hi. Tua hi a, gah hoih a gahlo singkung khempeuh kiphukin mei sungah kilawn hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin mihonpi in, "Tua ahihleh bangci hih ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in dong uh hi.
John in, "Puantual sungsilh nih a nei peuhpeuh in a neilo khat hawm henla an a nei peuhpeuh in zong tua bangin hih ta hen," ci hi.
Siahdongteh zong baptizena sang dingin hong pai uh a, John' kiangah, "Sya aw, bang ka cih ding uh hiam?" ci hi.
John in, "Hong kisawl zah khengvalin sum dong kei un," ci-in dawng hi.

Galkapte zong hong pai uh a, "Tua ahihleh kote in ka bangci hih ding uh hiam?" ci uh hi. John in, "Zawhthawh thu leh a maanlo pi-a ngawhna tawh kuama' sum sut kei unla, na khasum uh tawh lungkim un," ci hi.
Mite a lametna uh khangin a lungsim sung uhah John pen Khris ahikha ding hiam ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin

John in amaute khempeuh' kiangah, "Keimah in note tui tawh kong baptize hi. Ahi zongin kei sangin a thupizaw khat hong pai ding a, ama' khedap khau a phel ding nangawnin ka kilawm kei hi. Amah in note Kha Siangtho leh mei tawh hong baptize ding hi.
Amah in a khut ah buhpholhna singkai tawi-in buhphal cilna tual hahsiang ding a, buhtangte ansal sungah khawm ding hi. Ahi zongin buhvai ansite a mit ngeilo mei tawh haltum ding hi," ci hi.
Tu-a bangin John in hanthotna tuamtuam a dang tampi zangin mite' kiangah Lungdamna Thu tangko hi.
Ahih hangin Ukpi Herod in a sanggampa' zi Herodias a tenpihna hang leh ama' gitlohnate khempeuh hangin John ii taaina hilhna thuakkha ahih manin
tua a siatna teng khempeuh hih thu tawh behlap lai hi: John thong sungah khumcip hi.
Tu-in mi khempeuh kibaptize-in Jesu zong kibaptize a, thu a nget laitak vantung kihong hi.
Jesu' tungah gam vakhu bangin pumpi melpuakj tawh Kha Siangtho kumsuk a, vantung pan awging khat hong omin, "Nang pen kong it ka Tapa na hi hi; nang' tungah ka lungkim mahmah hi," ci hi.
Jesu ama' seppina a kipat hunin khankum sawmthum kiim pha hi. Amah pen Joseph' tapa (ahi dinga kingaihsun) hi a, Joseph pen Heli' tapa,
Heli pen Matthat' tapa, Matthat pen Levi' tapa, Levi pen Melchi' tapa, Melchi pen Jannai' tapa, Jannai pen Joseph' tapa,
Joseph pen Mattathias' tapa, Mattathias pen Amos' tapa, Amos pen Nahum' tapa, Nahum pen Esli' tapa, Esli pen Naggai' tapa,
Naggai pen Maath' tapa, Maath pen Mattathias' tapa, Mattathias pen Semein' tapa, Semein pen Josech' tapa, Josech pen Joda' tapa,
Joda pen Joanan' tapa, Joanan pen Rhesa' tapa, Rhesa pen Zerubbabel' tapa, Zerubbable pen Shealtiel' tapa, Shealtiel pen Neri' tapa,
Neri pen Melchi' tapa, Melchi pen Addi' tapa, Addi pen Cosam' tapa, Cosam pen Elmadam' tapa, Elmadam pen Er' tapa,
Er pen Joshua' tapa, Joshua pen Eliezer' tapa, Eliezer pen Jorim' tapa, Jorim pen Matthat' tapa, Matthat pen Levi' tapa,
Levi pen Simeon' tapa, Simeon pen Judah' tapa, Judah pen Joseph' tapa, Joseph pen Jonam' tapa, Jonam pen Eliakim' tapa,
Eliakim pen Melea' tapa, Melea pen Menna' tapa, Menna pen Mattatha' tapa, Mattatha pen Nathan' tapa, Nathan pen David' tapa,
David pen Jesse' tapa, Jesse pen Obed' tapa, Obed pen Boaz' tapa, Boaz pen Sala' tapa, Sala pen Nahshon' tapa,
Nahshon pen Amminadab' tapa, Amminadab pen Admin' tapa, Admin pen Arni' tapa, Arni pen Hezron' tapa, Hezron pen Perez' tapa, Perez pen Judah' tapa,
Judah pen Jacob' tapa, Jacob pen Isaac' tapa, Isaac pen Abraham' tapa, Abraham pen Terah' tapa, Terah pen Nahor' tapa,
Nahor pen Serug' tapa, Serug pen Reu' tapa, Reu pen Peleg' tapa, Peleg pen Eber' tapa, Eber pen Shelah' tapa,
Shelah pen Cainan' tapa, Cainan pen Arphaxad' tapa, Arphaxad pen Shem' tapa, Shem pen Noah' tapa, Noah pen Lamech' tapa,
Lamech pen Methuselah' tapa, Methuselah pen Enoch' tapa, Enoch pen Jared' tapa, Jared pen Mahalaleel' tapa, Mahalaleel pen Cainan' tapa,
Cainan pen Enos' tapa, Enos pen Seth' tapa, Seth pen Adam' tapa, Adam pen Pasian' tapa ahi hi.Jesu A Kisiatzolna
